entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both complete subsections and history. General venue has an otherwise-provided-by-law qualification; listed identity-theft provisions add victim residence and property-location choices. No extension to other offenses is implied.

headings.reviewNote: Any connected offense in originating or receiving county; no unrelated-offense extension.

headings.reviewNote: Trick/deception and listed nonexclusive crimes, no narrowing to completed theft.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and prior-revision notes. Property-related offense venue includes origin and destination counties; wrongfully taken is broader than stealing alone and includes the specified nonexclusive offenses. Titles do not invent a required conviction or narrow the definition.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all three subsections and history. Source connects subdivision (4) to (5) with and after earlier or clauses; neutral jurisdiction title does not resolve or rewrite that conjunction. Homicide impact/death results, a presumption rather than conclusive fact from finding a body, and land/water/airspace scope remain distinct.
